sentences.text: Neisseria species other than Neisseria gonorrhoeae and Neisseria meningitidis are normally part of the commensal bacterial flora of the human oropharynx.
Commensal members may also be protective: in human challenge studies Neisseria lactamica inhibited colonisation by Neisseria meningitidis.
Commensal Neisseria are regarded as an important reservoir of antimicrobial resistance genes for the pathogenic members of the genus.
